Title: Army Forge URL Source: https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/armyInfo/w70ha3o85pa7nigq/2/preview Markdown Content: [![Image 1: Home](https://army-forge.opr-cdn.com/app/onepagerules_round_128x128.png)](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/) Battle Brothers [Studio](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/studio "Army Forge Studio") [Sign In](https://army-forge.onepagerules.com/auth/signin) GF - Knight Brothers v3.5.3 ## Intro Battle Brother Detachments are elite battle companies of superhuman warriors with highly specialized training and tactics. Stranded in the Sirius Sector, the Detachments settled a number of worlds which they have adapted to their unique needs. The Detachments changed over time as well, becoming more distinct and developing their own ideas of how best to serve their Founder. Now, Detachments struggle to maintain a sense of unity and purpose as they become more distinct. ## About OPR OPR (www.onepagerules.com) is the home of many free games which are designed to be fast to learn and easy to play. This project was made by gamers for gamers and it can only exist thanks to the support of our awesome community. If you want to help us in making more awesome content, you can support us on www.patreon.com/onepagerules Thank you for playing! ## Background Story Following the genetic innovations of the Founder, the Battle Brothers were soon deployed to maintain unity and peace over Earth and its nearby colonies. Early space travel had proven an expensive and difficult process, and as a result, Battle Brothers were assigned to each colony as a permanent garrison. These garrisons were formed into the first Detachments, serving as their world’s first line of defence against insurgency and civil conflict. Detachments rapidly adapted to combat on their respective worlds, developing unique tactics, equipment and roles to excel in localized conflicts. By the time that the first wave of recruits had been fully trained, most Detachments had already developed their own unique culture, skills and traditions, which set them apart from the original Battle Brothers. Many Detachments became symbols of stability and cultural identity on their respective home worlds, gathering respect and political influence as their reputation grew. At the height of the Detachments’ influence, the Founder revealed his vision of a united and uplifted humanity, capable of thriving throughout the galaxy with the use of advanced gene-mods. In order to overcome political obstacles to his vision, the Founder led a daring coup to seize control of humanity’s colonies. Detachments moved quickly, with some declaring their loyalty to the Founder while others opposed him. This division sparked a long and destructive civil war which soon engulfed all of humanity. On Earth, the fighting was particularly fierce and some feared that it might leave the world uninhabitable. A portion of humanity chose to flee the situation, commandeering one of the Founder’s fleets. The Founder drew a number of Detachments from the front lines to pursue these refugees, but a massive wormhole left both fleets stranded in the Sirius Sector. The Battle Brothers moved quickly to establish themselves in the Sirius Sector, with each remaining detachment tasked with gathering their surviving members and settling on a world in order to best achieve the Founder’s vision. Their time in Sirius has given the detachments time to further specialize and hone their skills, building upon their predecessors in new ways. This has fostered a strong sense of independence and even rivalry among a number of detachments, united only by their loyalty to the original Founder and his successors, the Conduits. Aircraft, Fearless, Knightborn, Tough(9), Transport(11) | 640pts | 2 GF - Knight Brothers v3.5.3 ## Army-Wide Special Rule Knightborn:When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 4+ instead. ## Special Rules Evasive:Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where all models have this rule. Lacerate:When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6. Melee Shrouding:Enemies get -3" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule. Mend:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it. Rapid Rush:This model moves +6" when using Rush actions. Ravage:When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound. Re-Deployment:After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re-Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next. Re-Position Artillery:Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9". Shielded:Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells. Teleport:Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions. Unpredictable:When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unpredictable Fighter:When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead. Unstoppable Mark:Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply). Versatile Attack:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls. Versatile Reach:When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in it either get +4" range when shooting, or move +2" when charging. Warding:When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 4+ instead. ## Aura Special Rules Bane in Melee Aura:This model and its unit get Bane in melee. Bane when Shooting Aura:This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. Courage Aura:This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls. Melee Shrouding Aura:This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding. Rapid Rush Aura:This model and its unit get Rapid Rush. Regeneration Aura:This model and its unit get Regeneration. Unpredictable Fighter Aura:This model and its unit get Unpredictable Fighter. Versatile Reach Aura:This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. ## Army Spells **Knight Sight (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). **Knight Trauma (1):** Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. **Banishing Sigil (2):** Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which get -1 to defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply). **Doom Strike (2):** Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Deadly(3). **Knight Dome (3):** Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). **Purge the Impure (3):** Pick up to two enemy units within 12", which take 3 hits with AP(2) each. 3 GF -
